note: The fuzzer input buffer is passed directly into the config parser, with len reduced by one to leave a sentinel byte.
Lexer boundaries are initialized from the attacker-controlled buffer, so parsing decisions depend on input bytes.
An input beginning with triple quotes selects the multiline-string lexer state.
The lexer classifies the delimiter as double-quote multiline text and computes the terminating sequence.

code: do { if (!strncmp(lexer->pos, end, 3)) { emit(lexer, LEXEME_STRING); lexer->pos += 3; return lex_config; } } while (next(lexer) != '\0');
note: If the closing triple quotes are missing, the lexer scans until EOF while repeatedly reading attacker-controlled bytes; this is the sink path that matches the reported crash state.
